Theorem
[At most Euclidean volume growth (Theorem 27.42)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0045, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0046 ↗ thm:chow-iv-bakry-emery-comparison 1. ch27:27.42\group Volume growth

Every complete normalized noncompact shrinker satisfies \[ \operatorname {Vol}B_O(r)\le \omega _ne^{f(O)}r^n. \] If $O$ minimizes $f$, the factor is at most $e^{n/2}$.
